notes.title: Update 0.2 for FUR Squadron Phoenix Demo
notes.notes:
August 4th Updates
🚀 Mods Station

🔥 Overdrive system upgrades

🌈 HDR support now live

🎮 UI/UX improvements

🛠️ Minor gameplay fixes


Mods Station


FUR Squadron Phoenix is finally leaning into its roguelite core! Rack up Mod Points during your runs and spend them on upgrades for your Starfighter and Special Weapons. Changed your mind? No worries—you can reset anytime and experiment with new setups!


Overdrive Upgrades


Every time you complete a teammate’s task, your bond with that character will grow. Stronger relationships mean stronger Overdrive powers. Teamwork has never been so rewarding!


HDR support


We now support HDR displays! Get ready for brighter highlights, deeper shadows, and colors that really pop.
